list.title: Components
list.emptyBody: Link a main product to products that go well together to buy as a set.

gallery.title: Choose a template
gallery.subtitle: Select the component layout. You'll customize the style next.

editor.previewHelp: The preview uses samples when no products are selected. The actual position in your store is set by dragging the block in the theme editor.
editor.nameHelp: Only to identify it in the list. If empty, the main product's name is used.
editor.companionsEmpty: Select at least one companion product.
editor.directionUniHelp: Shows only on the main product's page.
editor.directionBiHelp: Shows on both: the main suggests the companion and vice versa.
editor.activeHelp: Turn off to hide without deleting.
editor.discountHelp: Applied at checkout when the customer takes 2 or more items from the component.
editor.showBuyNowHelp: Adds to cart and goes straight to checkout.
editor.showVariantPickerHelp: Lets the customer switch color/size without leaving the page.
editor.confirmDelete: Delete this component? This action cannot be undone.

errors.limitReached: You've reached your plan limit ({{limit}} products). Upgrade under "Plans".
errors.duplicate: A component already exists for this main product.
